service: Xiarch Global Enterprise IT & SecOps SLA Matrix

P1.name: Critical
P1.description: Enterprise-wide outage, ransomware incident, compromised domain admin, or active data exfiltration.

P2.name: High
P2.description: Single server/cluster disruption, high-risk security alert, compromised end-user account, or firewall change request.

P3.name: Medium
P3.description: Standard user access request, non-critical software failure, VPN connection issue, hardware replacement.

P4.name: Low
P4.description: General IT inquiry, non-urgent documentation request, peripheral order, feature request.
